<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Arts and culture;
*Following the [[suicide]] of a teenage boy from [[Radcliffe, Greater Manchester]] in [[England]] police issue a public statement and the coroner sends notices to schools warning of the game ''[[Doki Doki Literature Club!]]''. [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/newsmanchester/father-speaks-out-over-doki-doki-literature-club-psychological-horror-game-after-death-of-son/ar-AAz9lEq (MSN)]
;Business and economy
*[[2017–18 Iranian protests]], [[June 2018 Bazaar protests]]
**[[Tehran]]'s [[Grand Bazaar, Tehran|Grand Bazaar]] starts a large strike after [[Iranian rial]] plunged to a record low against the [[US dollar]] on the market. [https://en.trend.az/iran/politics/2921032.html (Trend)] [http://english.alarabiya.net/en/News/world/2018/06/25/WATCH-As-Iranian-rial-drops-hundreds-protest-failed-economic-policies-in-Tehran.html (Al-Arabiya)]
**[[Mohammad Javad Fathi]], a member of the parliament, resigns and says that he has no hope for change under [[Government of the Islamic Republic of Iran|the current system]]. [https://www.kaleme.com/1397/04/02/klm-267419/ (Kaleme)]
**Protesters angered by the economy confront police, as well as chanting "Death to Palestine". [http://www.jewishpress.com/news/eye-on-palestine/must-watch-iranian-protesters-chanting-death-to-palestine-as-economy-collapsing/2018/06/26/ (''The Jewish Press'')]
*[[Economy of the United States]]
**[[Harley-Davidson]], a US [[motorcycle]] manufacturer, states that it intends to shift export production for the EU overseas. The company reports that the decision is related to rocky trade relations between the [[European Union]] and the [[United States]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/business-44604280 (BBC)]
*[[Economy of Wales]]
**The government of the [[United Kingdom]] announces the cancellation of the [[Swansea Bay]] [[Tidal Lagoon Swansea Bay|tidal lagoon project]], prompting ire from [[Wales|Welsh]] officials. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-wales-south-west-wales-44589083 (BBC)]
*[[Expansion of Heathrow Airport]]
**The UK's [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]] votes 415–119 to approve a third runway at [[London]]'s [[Heathrow Airport]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-44609898 (BBC)]
*[[Greece|Greek]] offshore gas extraction firm [[Energean]], which is already developing gas fields off [[Israel]], is revealed to be contemplating an [[initial public offering]] to raise [[US$]]1.5 billion in order to develop [[Gaza Marine]], a gas deposit off [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. Shell, who own a 55% stake in Gaza Marine, have been attempting to sell their share as ongoing conflict prevents production. [https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/business/greece-s-energean-reportedly-in-talks-to-develop-gaza-s-gas-1.6201931 (''Haaretz'')]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Flash flood]]s and [[landslide]]s triggered by heavy rains kill at least seven people and leave 12 others missing in northern [[Vietnam]]. [https://www.news.com.au/world/breaking-news/seven-dead-in-vietnam-floods-landslides/news-story/e6bfcad116fd9afbee4ba79dfeee582e (News.com.au)]
*A [[Philippines|Filipino]] [[container ship]] runs aground on a [[coral reef]] near [[Raroia]], [[Tuamotus]], [[French Polynesia]]. [[France]] sends an aircraft to survey the scene in response to a request for help by Raroia's mayor. [https://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/360383/container-ship-runs-onto-reef-in-tuamotus (Radio NZ)]
*International mining firm [[BHP Billiton]] signs an agreement with [[Brazil]]ian authorities over criminal culpability and civil compensation liability over a mine site collapse that killed nineteen. The deal halts litigation for up to two years but does not confirm a final amount for a settlement. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-samarco-disaster/samarco-inks-deal-with-brazil-authorities-over-dam-disaster-vale-idUSKBN1JL2S9 (Reuters)]
;International relations
*[[Water conflicts between Malaysia and Singapore]]
**Malaysian Prime Minister [[Mahathir Mohamad]] announces his intention to renegotiate a 1962 water agreement with [[Singapore]], which the latter country regards as sacrosanct. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/singapore/mahathir-water-singapore-malaysia-price-ridiculous-10466780 (CNA)]
;Law and crime
*The [[Ethiopia]] Federal Police Commission announces the arrests of 30 people suspected of involvement in a bombing of a rally for [[Prime Minister of Ethiopia|Prime Minister]] [[Abiy Ahmed]]. The attack killed two and injured 156. The [[United States]] announces the deployment of [[FBI]] specialists to assist the probe. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-politics/us-to-send-fbi-experts-to-investigate-ethiopia-bomb-blast-idUSKBN1JL0V8 (Reuters)]
*[[Mexico|Mexican]] authorities arrest the entire police force of [[Ocampo Municipality, Michoacán|Ocampo, Michoacán]], on suspicion of murdering a mayoral candidate. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-latin-america-44597807 (BBC)]
*[[Zimbabwe]]an authorities report two people have died following Saturday's bomb attack on [[President of Zimbabwe|President]] [[Emmerson Mnangagwa]] in [[Bulawayo]], with several others in critical condition. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-44600373 (BBC)]  
*A judge in [[Nauru]] declares the Civil Procedures Amendment 2018 unconstitutional and strikes it down. The act restricted the ability of those facing prosecution to obtain legal representation. The court orders Nauru's government to pay [[Australia]]n lawyers acting for those who brought the legal challenge. [https://www.radionz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/360403/nauru-judge-throws-out-new-law (Radio NZ)]
*A ban on [[disposable product|single-use]] plastics including cups, bags, and bottles in [[Mumbai]], [[India]], comes into effect. Mumbai is the nation's largest city with such a law, and those in violation face fines and up to three months in prison. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jun/25/mumbai-india-bans-plastic-bags-and-bottles (''The Guardian'')]
*A [[U.S.]] judge dismisses legal action brought by two [[California]]n cities against oil companies, regarding their contributions towards [[climate change]]. [http://thehill.com/policy/energy-environment/394137-judge-dismisses-california-cities-climate-lawsuits-against-oil (''The Hill'')]
*[[Germany|German]] officials announce the arrest of a former aide to [[Osama bin Laden]] and plan to deport him to his native [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.yahoo.com/amphtml/news/germany-detains-former-bin-laden-aide-plans-deport-123629442.htm (Yahoo!)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Member of the European Parliament|Member]]s of the [[European Parliament]] vote to activate the [[European Union]]'s disciplinary process against [[Hungary]], citing alleged discrepancies administering the rule of law in the country under [[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/jun/25/mep-european-parliament-vote-eu-sanction-hungary-viktor-orban (''The Guardian'')]
